occurrence.label: Humanoid robot volume-production crossing

title: Humanoid robots are the retail story; harmonic-drive/actuator supply is not
thesis: Humanoid robot deployment crossed from pilot to real commercial volume in 2026 (Figure at BMW Spartanburg, 1,000+ Optimus units at Tesla, Agility's Digit at Amazon/Toyota, Apptronik's Apollo at Mercedes, Unitree shipping ~5,500 units in 2025) — a use case retail already prices through Tesla and thematic robotics ETFs. The link that actually gates how fast this scales — harmonic-drive/strain-wave gearboxes and integrated actuator modules, concentrated among a handful of Japanese and Chinese makers with structurally limited scale-up — is barely represented in retail portfolios despite fresh, quantifiable order-book evidence that it is the binding constraint.
why_now: Harmonic-drive lead times run 26+ weeks and the components are described as structurally harder to scale than electronics because of precision-manufacturing limits; Harmonic Drive Systems (Tokyo: 6324) reported FY2026/3 full-year orders up 16.2% to ¥61.6B with backlog up 13.6% to ¥21.9B, explicitly citing industrial-robot, semiconductor-equipment, and emerging AI-robot demand, and guided FY2027/3 operating income to more than double (+141.5%); Chinese challenger Leaderdrive grew FY2025 revenue 47.3% to ¥571M as humanoid programs scale procurement.
retail_gap: Retail humanoid exposure runs almost entirely through Tesla (Optimus) and thematic robotics ETFs holding household names; the actual gating suppliers (Harmonic Drive Systems, Nabtesco, Leaderdrive) sit at low single-digit weights inside niche thematic funds (e.g., ~2% each in KOID) and are essentially absent from mainstream retail discussion despite being named the structural bottleneck by industry researchers.

unmappedness.rationale: The humanoid-robot theme itself is fully discovered and already anchors method §3's 85+ 'GPU-class retail story' band — not unmapped. The actuator/gearbox link specifically is thinly held, now backed by fresh, dated order-book data showing it tightening in real time, and has not yet become a retail talking point: a genuine crowdedness gap sitting inside an otherwise crowded chain.

evidence.claim: Figure's humanoids have contributed to production of 30,000+ vehicles at BMW's Spartanburg plant running ten-hour shifts five days a week; Tesla has 1,000+ Optimus Gen 3 units working across its facilities on battery assembly and cable routing; Unitree shipped roughly 5,500 humanoid units in 2025, the highest volume of any producer globally.

Harmonic-drive lead times for humanoid actuators run 26+ weeks; unlike electronics, harmonic gearboxes are structurally hard to scale because of precision-manufacturing constraints, and the supply base is concentrated among Harmonic Drive Systems, Nabtesco, and Chinese entrant Leaderdrive.
evidence.source_name: Roland Berger 2026 humanoid robotics study / KraneShares humanoid robotics research

evidence.claim: Harmonic Drive Systems (TYO:6324) reported FY2026/3 full-year orders up 16.2% to ¥61.6B and order backlog up 13.6% to ¥21.9B, citing industrial-robot, semiconductor-equipment, and emerging AI-robot demand, and guided FY2027/3 operating income to rise 141.5%; Chinese competitor Leaderdrive grew FY2025 revenue 47.3% to ¥571M.
